source.actualChildOperations: Captured private operations; constructor labels are DATA and do not create or qualify native owners.

selection.roadmapLane: P2 backend/client lifecycle; independent of DP work production and main/CI scheduling.
selection.basis: A finite source-bound conditional fault was independently reproduced. Missing coverage alone was not treated as novelty.
selection.ownership: Primary self-implementation; no external worker dispatch, task messaging or automation changes.
selection.finiteChange: Latch the close invocation before entering the private child, independently of its return value; catch a synchronous throw and reuse the existing unobservable-close failure path.
selection.retainedCoverage: All14 authored receipt/core/borrowed-V2/V3 registrations are retained. Only one core sourceSpecs tuple in each of the two compatibility entries changes; complete inverse recovers each previous file.

baseline.zeroExitMeaning: The diagnostic captured the expected old faults; it does not mean the faulty implementation passed the fixed contract.
baseline.commandClass: One explicit old-core module path, env -i, three exact fs-read grants, no writes/children/workers/addons.

implementation.latch: closeCalls is set before CHILD_CLOSE; a repeated or reentrant invocation never calls that child again, including null/undefined returns.
implementation.synchronousThrow: Discard the thrown value without reading hooks; return undefined because no native close Promise was obtained.
implementation.hold: Use CLOSE_UNOBSERVABLE / UNOBSERVABLE and unknownUndrained; release queued entries and fail the one-shot run once its active callback is observed.
implementation.laterFailureClassification: Later active-entry processing may refine failure to CHILD_UNCERTAINTY or ENTRY_REJECTED. It never clears the failed/unobservable close.
implementation.validPromise: Return the identical actual native close Promise; no substitute, chained Promise or cleanup acknowledgement is introduced.
implementation.reentrantCloseBeforeChildReturn: Returns the existing null slot, not a new Promise. The outer valid child Promise is retained when the child returns.
